definitions.gloss: to be cooked through; to be heated all the way through
definitions.explanation: Of food being cooked: to become fully heated or cooked inside. The intransitive partner of the expression meaning 'to cook through'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{火|ひ}が{通|とお}った。
⟦じゃがいも→じゃがいも：05184_jagaimo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{火|ひ}が{通|とお}る⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧。
examples.english: Simmer until the potatoes are cooked through.

examples.japanese: {竹串|たけぐし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{通|とお}れば→通る：01243_tooru⟧、⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}っている→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧です。
examples.english: If a bamboo skewer goes in easily, that shows it's cooked all the way through.

notes:
Conjugates like ⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ (godan, intransitive). The food takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{火|ひ}が{通|とお}る. A recipe staple, especially ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{火|ひ}が{通|とお}る⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ (until ~ is cooked through).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{火|ひ}が{通|とお}る: to be cooked to the center
- {火|ひ}が{通|とお}りやすい: cooks quickly
- {火|ひ}が{通|とお}る⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ / ⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧: to grill / simmer until cooked through

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive partner of ⟦{火|ひ}を{通|とお}す→火を通す：34055_hiwotoosu⟧ (to cook through): ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{火|ひ}を{通|とお}す→火を通す：34055_hiwotoosu⟧ (I cook the meat through) → ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{火|ひ}が{通|とお}る (the meat is cooked through).
